mechanic: Thiên Hà: mỗi trận đấu diễn ra trong một Thiên Hà với luật chơi riêng.

traits.name: Thời Không
traits.description:
Đội của bạn nhận @PercentAttackSpeed@% Tốc Độ Đánh khi bắt đầu giao tranh và sau mỗi vài giây.

(@MinUnits@) @Frequency@ giây
(@MinUnits@) @Frequency@ giây
(@MinUnits@) @Frequency@ giây
(@MinUnits@) @Frequency@ giây

traits.name: Nổi Loạn
traits.description:
@ShieldDuration@ giây sau khi bắt đầu giao tranh, các tướng Nổi Loạn nhận Lá Chắn và sát thương cộng thêm với mỗi tướng Nổi Loạn liền kề.

(@MinUnits@) @ShieldAmount@ Lá Chắn; +@DamageAmp@% sát thương cộng thêm

traits.name: Không Tặc
traits.description:
Có tỉ lệ rơi ra thêm vật phẩm khi Không Tặc hạ sát đối thủ.

(@MinUnits@) @CoinDropChance@% rơi ra 1 vàng
(@MinUnits@) và @ItemDropChance@% rơi ra 1 trang bị

traits.name: Ma Tặc
traits.description:
(@MinUnits@) Đòn đánh của tướng Ma Tặc gây hiệu ứng Phá Năng Lượng.

Phá Năng Lượng: Tăng @CostIncreasePercent@% Năng Lượng tối đa cho tới lần thi triển tiếp theo.

traits.name: Mật Thám
traits.description:
Nội tại: Khi bắt đầu chiến đấu, các tướng Mật Thám nhảy ra tuyến sau đội hình đối thủ.

Mật Thám được tăng Tốc Độ Đánh trong @Duration@ giây khi giao tranh bắt đầu, tái tạo lại hiệu ứng khi tham gia hạ gục kẻ địch.

(@MinUnits@) @AttackSpeedPercent@% %i:scaleAS%

traits.name: Hắc Tinh
traits.description:
Mỗi khi có tướng đồng minh bị hạ gục, tướng Hắc Tinh nhận thêm Sức Mạnh Công Kích và Sức Mạnh Phép Thuật.

(@MinUnits@) +@ADandSP@% %i:scaleAD%, +@ADandSP@ %i:scaleAP%

traits.name: Bắn Tỉa
traits.description:
Bắn Tỉa gây thêm sát thương với mỗi ô khoảng cách từ họ đến mục tiêu.

(@MinUnits@) +@PercentDamageIncrease@% mỗi ô

traits.name: Kiếm Khách
traits.description:
Đòn đánh của Kiếm Khách có tỉ lệ đánh thêm lên mục tiêu hiện tại.

(@MinUnits@) @ProcChance@% tỉ lệ. @ExtraAttacks@ đòn đánh thêm.

traits.name: Phù Thủy
traits.description:
Đội của bạn nhận Sức Mạnh Phép Thuật.

(@MinUnits@) @AP@ %i:scaleAP%

traits.name: Đấu Sĩ
traits.description:
Đấu Sĩ nhận thêm Máu.

(@MinUnits@) +@BonusHealth@ %i:scaleHealth%

traits.name: Mẫu Hạm
traits.description: (@MinUnits@) Mẫu Hạm được hồi @ManaPerSecond@ Năng Lượng mỗi giây, di chuyển dọc theo bản đồ và miễn nhiễm hiệu ứng hạn chế di chuyển, nhưng không thể đánh thường.

traits.name: Bí Ẩn
traits.description:
Đội của bạn nhận thêm Kháng Phép.

(@MinUnits@) @MagicResist@ %i:scaleMR%

traits.name: Bộc Phá
traits.description: <expandRow>(@MinUnits@) Kỹ năng của tướng Bộc Phá sẽ Làm Choáng kẻ địch trong @StunDuration@ giây. (1 lần mỗi khi thi triển)</expandRow>

traits.name: Hộ Vệ
traits.description:
Mỗi khi Hộ Vệ thi triển kỹ năng, họ nhận được Lá Chắn trong @Duration@ giây.

(@MinUnits@) @ShieldPercent@% tối đa %i:scaleHealth%

traits.name: Siêu Công Nghệ
traits.description:
Tướng Siêu Công Nghệ có ít nhất 1 trang bị sẽ nhận thêm Sức Mạnh Công Kích và Máu.

(@MinUnits@) +@ADAmp*100@% %i:scaleAD%, +@HealthAmp@ %i:scaleHealth%

traits.name: Pháo Thủ
traits.description:
Mỗi đòn đánh thứ tư, Pháo Thủ sẽ tấn công thêm vào mục tiêu ngẫu nhiên. Đòn đánh thêm có thể chí mạng.

(@MinUnits@) @AdditionalAttacks@ Đòn Đánh Thêm

traits.name: Ngoại Binh
traits.description: (@MinUnits@) Nội tại: Tướng Ngoại Binh có thể mua nâng cấp kỹ năng trong cửa hàng.

traits.name: Vũ Trụ
traits.description:
Đội của bạn nhận Hút Máu Toàn Phần.

(@MinUnits@) @HealPercent@% Hút Máu Toàn Phần

traits.name: Vệ Binh Tinh Tú
traits.description:
Mỗi khi tướng Vệ Binh Tinh Tú thi triển kỹ năng, một lượng Năng Lượng sẽ được chia đều cho tất cả Vệ Binh Tinh Tú khác.

(@MinUnits@) @ManaRestore@ %i:scaleMana%

traits.name: Tiên Phong
traits.description:
Tiên Phong nhận thêm Giáp.

(@MinUnits@) @Armor@ %i:scaleArmor%

traits.name: Thánh Nữ
traits.description: <expandRow>(@MinUnits@) Đòn đánh và kĩ năng của Thánh Nữ luôn chí mạng với mục tiêu dưới @PercentHealth@% máu. </expandRow>

traits.name: Hư Không
traits.description: (@MinUnits@) Đòn đánh và kĩ năng của tướng Hư Không gây sát thương chuẩn.

traits.name: Phi Công
traits.description:
(@MinUnits@) Bắt Đầu Giao Tranh: 3 tướng Phi Công ngẫu nhiên hợp thể thành 1 Siêu Chiến Giáp.

Siêu Chiến Giáp sở hữu Tộc/Hệ, 3 trang bị ngẫu nhiên, và nhận 65% tổng Máu cũng như Sức Mạnh Công Kích của các tướng Phi Công.

Khi Siêu Chiến Giáp bị hạ gục, các tướng Phi Công sẽ thoát ra với @EjectedPilotHealthPercent@% Máu tối đa.

ability.name: Bomb!
ability.description: Ziggs throws a bomb at an enemy, dealing @ModifiedDamage@ magic damage.

ability.name: Get Excited!
ability.description:
Passive: Jinx gets excited as she helps take down enemy units!

After her first takedown, Jinx gains @PercentAttackSpeed@ bonus Attack Speed.

After her second takedown, Jinx swaps to her rocket launcher, causing her Basic Attacks to deal @ModifiedDamage@ bonus magic damage to all enemies in a small area around her target.

ability.name: Aria of Perseverance
ability.description: Sona heals @NumberOfTargets@ injured allies for @ModifiedHealing@ and cleanses them of stuns.

ability.name: Last Breath
ability.description: Yasuo blinks to the farthest enemy in range, knocks them up for @StunDuration@ seconds, and Attacks them @ModifiedAttacks@ times (applies on-hit effects).

ability.name: Energy Shield
ability.description: Passive: Malphite starts combat with a shield equal to @ModifiedPercentHealth@ of his maximum health.

ability.name: Chosen One
ability.description: For @Duration@ seconds Master Yi gains massively increased movement speed, heals for @ModifiedHeal@ of his maximum health each second, and deals @ModifiedDamage@ bonus true damage with his Basic Attacks.

ability.name: Mobilize the Fleet
ability.description:
Aurelion Sol launches fighters which fly out to random enemies, deal @ModifiedDamage@ magic damage, and then return. Aurelion Sol launches all ready fighters, plus @FightersPerCast@ more, when he casts.

Fighters prefer to target nearby enemies.

ability.name: Bullet Time
ability.description: Miss Fortune channels and fires waves of bullets in a cone for @ChannelDuration@ seconds, dealing @ModifiedPercentHealth@ of enemies' maximum health in magic damage over the duration.

ability.name: Missile Rain
ability.description: Kai'Sa launches @NumMissiles@ missiles towards each nearby enemy that deal @ModifiedDamage@ magic damage.

ability.name: Ascend
ability.description: Kayle Ascends, causing her attacks to launch waves that deal @ModifiedDamage@ bonus magic damage.

ability.name: Chronobreak
ability.description:
Ekko shatters the timeline, freezing all units in time before attacking each enemy with @ModifiedDamage@ bonus magic damage and applying on-hit effects.

Ekko cannot die while he has stopped time.

ability.name: Riposte
ability.description: Fiora enters a defensive stance for @BlockDuration@ seconds, becoming immune to damage and enemy spell effects. As she exits this stance, she ripostes, dealing @ModifiedDamage@ magic damage to a nearby enemy and stunning them for @StunDuration@ seconds.

ability.name: Assault and Battery
ability.description: Vi charges at the farthest enemy, knocking aside all enemies in her path and dealing them @ModifiedSecondaryDamage@ magic damage. When she reaches her target, she knocks them up for @CCDuration@ seconds and deals @ModifiedPrimaryDamage@ magic damage.

ability.name: Bladesurge
ability.description: Irelia dashes to her target, Basic Attacking them for @ModifiedPercentAD@ of her Attack Damage. If this kills the target, she Bladesurges again immediately at the enemy with the highest mana. (Total Damage: @TooltipDamage@)

ability.name: Buckler Toss
ability.description: Poppy throws her buckler at the furthest enemy, dealing @ModifiedDamage@ magic damage. The buckler then bounces back, granting Poppy a shield that blocks @ModifiedShield@ damage.

ability.name: Wish
ability.description: Soraka heals all of her allies for @ModifiedHeal@.

ability.name: Orb of Deception
ability.description: Ahri fires an orb in a line, dealing @ModifiedDamage@ magic damage to all enemies it passes through on the way out, and @ModifiedDamage@ true damage on the way back.

ability.name: Unleashed Power
ability.description:
Syndra pulls in all orbs on the battlefield and creates @Spheres@ new ones, then fires them all at the enemy with the highest current Health percentage, dealing @ModifiedDamage@ magic damage per orb.

Lowest total health breaks targeting ties.

ability.name: Pop Blossom
ability.description: Neeko leaps into the air and slams into the ground, dealing @ModifiedDamage@ magic damage to all nearby enemies and stunning them for @StunDuration@ seconds.

ability.name: Orbital Strike
ability.description: Gangplank calls down an orbital strike around his target, dealing @ModifiedDamage@ damage to all enemies in a large area after @ImpactDelayTime@ seconds.

ability.name: Dreadnova Guillotine
ability.description:
Darius dunks an enemy, dealing @ModifiedDamage@ magic damage. If this kills the target, Darius immediately casts again.

Targets below @HealthThreshold@% health take double damage.

ability.name: To the Skies!
ability.description: Jayce slams his hammer, dealing @ModifiedDamage@ magic damage to nearby enemies.

ability.name: Galaxy Shield-Blast
ability.description: Annie blasts a cone of fire dealing @ModifiedDamage@ magic damage to enemies in front of her, then creates a shield with @ModifiedShield@ health for herself for @ShieldDuration@ seconds.

ability.name: Chum the Waters
ability.description: Fizz throws a lure that attracts a shark. It deals @ModifiedDamage@ magic damage to enemies caught, knocking them back and stunning them for @StunDuration@ seconds.

ability.name: Flamespitter
ability.description: Rumble torches his enemies, dealing @ModifiedDamage@ magic damage over @Duration@ seconds, and reducing healing on them by @GrievousWoundsPercent@% for @GrievousWoundsDuration@ seconds.

ability.name: Rupture
ability.description: Cho'Gath ruptures a large area, dealing @ModifiedDamage@ magic damage and knocking up all enemies within for @KnockDuration@ seconds.

ability.name: Taste their Fear
ability.description: Kha'Zix slashes the nearest enemy, dealing @ModifiedDamage@ magic damage. If the enemy has no adjacent allies, this damage is increased to @ModifiedIsolationDamage@.

ability.name: Lifeform Disintegration Ray
ability.description: Vel'Koz channels a ray of energy that sweeps across the battlefield over @ChannelDuration@ seconds, dealing @ModifiedDamage@ magic damage per second to enemies hit.

ability.name: E.M.P.
ability.description: Ezreal fires an electromagnetic pulse at a random enemy that explodes on impact, dealing @ModifiedDamage@ damage to all nearby enemies and increasing the cost of their next spellcast by @PercentCostIncrease@%.

ability.name: Future's Refuge
ability.description: Shen creates a zone around himself for @ZoneDuration@ seconds, in which all nearby allies automatically dodge incoming Basic Attacks. While it's active, Shen gains @ModifiedMR@ Magic Resist.

ability.name: Cyclone
ability.description: Wukong spins, dealing @ModifiedDamage@ magic damage to nearby enemies over @Duration@ seconds. The first time Wukong hits each enemy, he knocks them into the air and stuns them for @StunDuration@ seconds.

ability.name: Temporal Passage
ability.description: Thresh tosses his lantern towards @UnitCount@ random unit(s) on your bench, pulling them into combat and granting them @ModifiedMana@ bonus Mana. Traits are unaffected.

ability.name: Ace In The Hole
ability.description: Caitlyn takes aim at the farthest enemy, firing a deadly bullet towards them that deals @ModifiedDamage@ magic damage to the first enemy it hits.

ability.name: Wild Cards
ability.description: Twisted Fate throws three cards in a cone that deal @ModifiedDamage@ magic damage to each enemy they pass through.

ability.name: Three Talon Strike
ability.description: Xin Zhao quickly strikes his target three times, dealing Basic Attack damage and applying on-hit effects. The third strike knocks his target up for @StunDuration@ seconds and deals @ModifiedDamage@ bonus magic damage.

ability.name: Mass Polymorph
ability.description: Lulu polymorphs the @NumTargets@ nearest enemies for @Duration@ seconds, causing them to hop aimlessly, unable to attack or cast. Polymorphed enemies take @ModifiedBonusDamage@ additional damage from all sources.

ability.name: Force Pulse
ability.description: Kassadin releases a wave of energy in front of him, dealing @ModifiedDamage@ magic damage and disarming all targets hit for @Duration@ seconds.

ability.name: Deadly Plumage
ability.description: Xayah creates a storm of feather-blades, gaining @ModifiedAS@ Attack Speed for @Duration@ seconds.

ability.name: Grand Entrance
ability.description: Rakan dashes to the furthest enemy within range and leaps into the air, knocking them up for @StunDuration@ seconds and dealing @ModifiedDamage@ magic damage.

ability.name: Enchanted Crystal Arrow
ability.description: Ashe fires an arrow at the farthest enemy that explodes on the first target hit, dealing @ModifiedDamage@ magic damage to all nearby enemies and stunning them for @StunDurationPerSquare@ seconds.

ability.name: Indestructible
ability.description: Mordekaiser gains a shield for that absorbs @ModifiedShield@ damage over @Duration@ seconds. While the shield persists, Mordekaiser deals @ModifiedDamage@ magic damage per second to all nearby enemies.

ability.name: Lurid Binding
ability.description: Lux fires a sphere of darkness towards the farthest enemy. Enemies in its path take @ModifiedDamage@ magic damage and are stunned for @StunDuration@ seconds.

ability.name: Deceive
ability.description: Shaco teleports and backstabs his target for @TooltipPercentage@ of his Basic Attack damage. This is also always a critical hit. (Total: @TooltipADBonus@)

ability.name: Ageless Standard
ability.description: Jarvan calls down his standard to a nearby location, granting all nearby allies @ModifiedAS@ Attack Speed for @Duration@ seconds.

ability.name: Inspire
ability.description:
At start of combat, Karma bonds to her closest ally.

Karma grants the bonded ally (or a random one if that ally is dead) a @ModifiedShield@-health shield for @Duration@ seconds. While the shield holds, the ally receives @ModifiedAS@ bonus Attack Speed.

ability.name: Whisper
ability.description:
Passive: Jhin converts each 1% of bonus Attack Speed he has into 0.8 Attack Damage.

Passive: Every fourth shot, Jhin deals @ModifiedPercent@ damage. (Total: @TooltipDamage@)

ability.name: Sleepy Trouble Bubble
ability.description:
Zoe kicks a bubble at the enemy with the the highest current Health percentage, stunning them for @StunDuration@ seconds and dealing @ModifiedDamage@ magic damage.

Highest total health breaks targeting ties.

ability.name: Rocket Grab
ability.description:
Blitzcrank pulls the farthest enemy, dealing @ModifiedDamage@ magic damage and stunning them for @StunDuration@ seconds.

His next attack after pulling knocks up for 1 second.

Allies within range will prefer to attack Blitzcrank's target.

ability.name: Cyber Barrier
ability.description: Leona creates a barrier, reducing all incoming damage by @ModifiedDamageReduction@ for 4 seconds.

ability.name: Relentless Pursuit
ability.description: Lucian dashes away from his current target, then Basic Attacks them and fires a second shot which deals @ModifiedDamage@ magic damage.

ability.name: Smoke Grenade
ability.description: Graves launches a smoke grenade toward the enemy with the most Attack Speed. The grenade explodes on impact dealing @ModifiedDamage@ magic damage to nearby enemies and causing their attacks to miss for @BlindDuration@ seconds.

ability.name: Abyssal Bombardment
ability.description: Xerath transforms, summoning meteors to strike random foes in place of his normal attacks for @Duration@ seconds. Meteors deal @ModifiedDamage@ magic damage upon impact and if they kill their target, all adjacent enemies take @ModifiedAoEDamage@ magic damage and are stunned for @StunDuration@ seconds.
